simple: Fortinet’s response automation platform (SOAR): playbooks from simple to complex, incident and case management, 700+ ready-made connectors to SIEM, EDR, firewalls, clouds, IT and OT systems, and 6,500+ ready playbooks and 100+ solution packs in the Content Hub. AI agents investigate incidents, reason and respond on their own — the subscription includes 5 million FortiAI tokens per month (about 60 investigations). A virtual machine in your own data center or cloud, or a dedicated instance hosted by Fortinet; Enterprise and Starter (up to 10,000 actions per day) editions for small teams and pilots, with high-availability, disaster-recovery and air-gapped options. Threat intelligence management (TIM) is a separate module.
